title: Parrot Commentator Loses It, Capybara Says One Word 🦜
description:
One word. Total silence. 🦜🤫 Rico the parrot screams so loud the microphone squeals, until Kapi the capybara walks over, takes the mic and says: "Chill." Then he sinks a shot without looking.

Kapi in the League, Episode 4: Rico Loses It. A 3D animated basketball comedy about a very calm capybara, a very big bear (Bruno) and a very fast rabbit (Bunny), with Rico the parrot on the mic.

▶️ Start from Episode 1, Season Opener: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/ULDSAqNZm8g
👉 Next episode: Overtime. Subscribe to Kapi's World so you don't miss it!
💬 What's the one word that calms YOU down? Tell us in the comments!

Made with AI-assisted animation tools. The characters and the story are original.
